name: FUJIFILM Holdings Corporation
summary: FUJIFILM Holdings Corporation provides products and services in the fields of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. Its Healthcare segment offers products and services, such as medical devices, biomedical contract development and manufacturing organization, pharmaceutical, regenerative medicine, and cosmetics and supplements in the areas of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment; equipment and materials for medical systems; drug discovery support, such as iPS cells; and cell culture media and reagents.
